outcome: Incidence of transient asymptomatic hydronephrosis following total hysterectomy
Degree of hydronephrosis (graded I, II, or III)
cohort: 368 women who underwent a total abdominal or vaginal hysterectomy over a 4-year period.
finding: Transient hydronephrosis occurred in 9.5% of patients within three days after uncomplicated total hysterectomy, with the right kidney more frequently affected, and resolved spontaneously in most cases.
